text:
maria: spotting ~12% of requests from partner X failing 502 at the proxy since 02:05 UTC, looks correlated with the new strict routing rule we shipped last night
aj: yep, saw the same in dashboard traces — rule matched on header X-Client-Type and dropped to fallback cluster which doesn't have the new schema
samir: do we have an emergency path to let those through to the legacy route while we sync schemas?
lina: we do: there's a conditional allowlist switch in the gateway config. it's not exposed in console for safety, but we can flip via the config service. following runbook: set allowlist for header X-Partner-ID=partner-x for route /v1/sessions
maria: we should do a canary first (small %), not full flip. traffic is peaky. canary = 5% route-exception for partner-x
aj: agreed. i'll prepare the CLI command and post it here for approval. need two approvals from eng-platform or oncall
samir: +1 from me. i'll watch metrics (errors, latency, 5xx rate) and hold the rollback key
ops-bot: deploy-request received: maria requested config:update gateway.allowlist.partner-x canary=5% target=/v1/sessions
maria: command to apply (internal config-api):
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/v1/gateway/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CONFIG_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"gateway","key":"allowlist.partner-x","value":{"enabled":true,"target":"/v1/sessions","match":{"header":"X-Partner-ID","value":"partner-x"},"canary":5}}'
```
aj: posting approval: 
- aj: approve
- lina: approve
- samir: approve
maria: executing now
ops-bot: config:update accepted (tx=cfg_0a9b). change will rollout to proxies in 30s
sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards: added temporary panel for partner-x 5xx and latency. will alert if >2% 5xx sustained for 3m
maria: initial roll out looks good. partner-x 5xx dropped from 12% -> 1.8% within 45s
aj: increase canary to 20% after 5m if stable? suggestion: step to 20 -> 60 -> 100 over 30m windows
samir: i'm cautious — we need to ensure legacy cluster capacity. let's hold at 20% for 10m then reassess
ops-bot: config:update accepted (tx=cfg_0b3d). allowlist.partner-x canary=20%
maria: metrics stable at 20% window, CPU on legacy cluster increased but within autoscale headroom
lina: i'm updating the runbook to include this conditional allowlist flow + the exact CLI snippets. also adding note: always require 2 approvals and an oncall watch for at least 15m
aj: quick postmortem note: cause = strict route matching change that didn't account for partner-x schema lag. mitigation = conditional allowlist toggle + gradual canary
samir: action items: (1) add automated smoke check for partner-x in preprod; (2) add schema compatibility gate to route rollout; (3) surface allowlist switches in console in a read-only mode for audits
maria: closing loop: will keep allowlist at 20% for 1h then ramp to 100% if stable. if error >2% rollback to previous config with tx=cfg_0a9b (ops-bot can run rollback command)
ops-bot: rollback command: 
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/v1/gateway/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CONFIG_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tx":"cfg_0a9b"}'
```
sre-oncall: filed incident INC-2026-452 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-452) and will keep watch. tagging infra and product owners for partner-x
maria: thanks everyone. marking thread resolved in ticket and adding follow-up doc to eng-platform wiki with timeline and playbook updates :thumbsup:
